evidence.observation: Repair-in-place Python sessionizer under /app/sessions; binding contract, CLI modes, journal/open-state persistence, idempotent digests, catalog-backed last_run/ops-report, warehouse must stay untouched.
Oncall lists mixed-tenant closes, late misclassification after high anchor, --reset-output wiping journal, and seq stuck at 1 — maps directly to starter defects found by search.
Captured run shows tenants_seen=acme,beta for one u1 key, late events classified on_time, journal rewrite with seq=1, and --reset-output clearing watermark.journal.
session_key discards tenant_id and returns ('*', user_id), which merges tenants that share a user id.
--reset-output clears watermark.journal; _touch_runtime runs before argv validation; process_events called with use_arrival_gap=True.
append_journal write_text-overwrites the journal with hard-coded seq=1 instead of appending monotonic seq.
track.record updates max_observed before classify_lateness, violating contract advance order (compare then update).
record() assigns event_time_ms outright instead of observe()/max, allowing max_observed and watermark to step backward.
When use_arrival_gap is true, gap closes use arrival_index*1000 synthetic times rather than event_time_ms.
Contract fully specifies event-time half-open sessions, lateness/watermark order, journal non-decreasing watermark, CLI exit-2 pre-mutation, catalog gap overlay, and idempotent re-runs.
No disposable Harbor/oracle run was performed; EXECUTION set to SIMULATION_NOT_EXECUTED and verifier result NOT_RUN rather than inventing a score.
